name: SAARC
shortDescription: South Asian cultural society celebrating diversity and traditions
whatTheyDo: Organize cultural events, festivals, and celebrations showcasing South Asian heritage through music, dance, and art.
whyJoin: Connect with South Asian culture and traditions
Participate in vibrant festivals and celebrations
whyNotJoin: Requires time commitment for event planning
idealPerson: Someone passionate about cultural diversity, enjoys event planning, and loves celebrating traditions
pastEvents: Cultural Showcase - Music and dance performances

name: DOSSOM
shortDescription: Department of Stage, Sound, and Music - campus entertainment hub
whatTheyDo: Manage stage performances, sound systems, and music events across campus. Handle technical aspects of all major shows.
whyJoin: Get hands-on experience with stage equipment
idealPerson: Tech-savvy individuals who enjoy behind-the-scenes work, have patience for technical details, and don't mind irregular hours
pastEvents: Freshers Night - Sound and lighting setup

name: DOPY
shortDescription: Department of Photography - capturing campus memories
whatTheyDo: Cover all campus events through photography and videography. Create visual stories and maintain campus archives.
whyJoin: Free entry to all campus events
whyNotJoin: Must be available during most events
idealPerson: Creative individuals with an eye for detail, patient with editing work, and willing to capture moments rather than just attend events

name: DOSAR
shortDescription: Department of Art - expressing creativity through visual arts
whatTheyDo: Organize art exhibitions, workshops, and creative sessions. Handle all visual design needs for campus events.
idealPerson: Creative minds who enjoy visual expression, patient with iterative work, and open to artistic experimentation

name: DOFAM
shortDescription: Department of Films and Media - storytelling through cinema
whatTheyDo: Create short films, documentaries, and media content. Screen movies and organize film appreciation sessions.
idealPerson: Storytellers who are passionate about cinema, comfortable with collaborative work, and willing to invest time in production

name: FMAC
shortDescription: Film Music and Arts Club - harmony of sound and vision
whatTheyDo: Blend music, film, and performing arts. Organize concerts, music productions, and multimedia performances.
idealPerson: Musicians and performers who love collaboration, aren't afraid of stage presence, and enjoy fusion of different art forms

name: Devsoc
shortDescription: Developer's Society - coding and software development community
whatTheyDo: Conduct hackathons, coding workshops, and tech talks. Build projects and prepare students for tech careers.
whyNotJoin: Constantly evolving technology requires continuous learning
idealPerson: Problem-solvers who love coding, are comfortable with self-learning, and enjoy building things from scratch

name: ERC
shortDescription: Electronics and Robotics Club - building intelligent machines
whatTheyDo: Design robots, work on electronics projects, and compete in technical competitions. Focus on hardware and embedded systems.
whyJoin: Learn PCB design and embedded systems
idealPerson: Hands-on learners who enjoy tinkering with hardware, have patience for debugging, and aren't afraid of soldering irons
pastEvents: Arduino Workshop Series - Basics to advanced

name: SAIDL
shortDescription: Society for AI and Deep Learning - exploring machine intelligence
whatTheyDo: Research and implement AI/ML projects. Study neural networks, computer vision, and natural language processing.
idealPerson: Math enthusiasts who love data, are comfortable with research papers, and have patience for model training iterations
pastEvents: Research Paper Reading Group - Weekly sessions

name: Algomaniax
shortDescription: Competitive programming club - mastering algorithms and data structures
whatTheyDo: Train for coding competitions, solve algorithmic problems, and prepare for technical interviews at top companies.
whyJoin: Compete in ICPC and other contests
idealPerson: Logical thinkers who enjoy puzzles, can handle competitive pressure, and are willing to grind through difficult problems

name: Athletics
shortDescription: Track and field club - speed, endurance, and athletic excellence
whatTheyDo: Train for track and field events, organize sports meets, and represent college in inter-college competitions.
idealPerson: Athletic individuals who enjoy outdoor activities, have discipline for regular training, and love competitive sports

name: BGSC
shortDescription: Ball Games and Sports Club - team sports and recreation
whatTheyDo: Organize football, basketball, volleyball, and other ball games. Conduct tournaments and coaching sessions.
idealPerson: Team players who enjoy ball sports, are comfortable with physical activity, and like recreational competition

name: DOJMA
shortDescription: Department of Journalism and Mass Arts - media and communication
whatTheyDo: Manage campus newsletter, conduct interviews, write articles, and handle PR for college events.
idealPerson: Curious individuals who love storytelling, are comfortable with writing, and enjoy meeting new people
